# kiro hook payloads, typed from the documentation

Not captured: Cortex has not run this agent live. Each file is a payload written by hand on
2026-11-06 from the fields the agent's hook documentation lists for its event, with values of the
kind the captured Claude Code and Codex payloads hold: the repository at `C:\repo`, session
`00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001`, and the capture repository's file `calc/ops.py`. A field
the documentation does not name is left out, so a tool whose input fields it does not name has an
empty input here. When the agent is run live, captured payloads replace these.

Kiro's documentation gives these bodies in full for its older command-line agent only, with event
names in camel case; the event names here are its current triggers', in Pascal case, as its
current pages write them.
